an5.47:2.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
an5.47:2.3: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
an5.47:3.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
an5.47:4.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti. (ye te dhammā …pe… kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsenti. tathārūpāssa dhammā) …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an5.47:5.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
an5.47:6.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
